device.model: Mini Combo HD SE (System ID 14020A00, v2.3.45 EMU)
device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD Combo receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.board: 14020A00 (bootloader version "M3516C 1.2.1", 16 MB SPI flash, 256 MB DDR3 M3503 revision B platform)
device.soc: ALi M3516C / M3503 rev B (256 MB DDR3 dual-CPU SoC reading chip ID 0x3503 rev 0x0001; seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200)
device.demod: internal ALi M3503 / M3516C DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503_0) + DVB-T2/C (NIM_COFDM_0)

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_MiniComboHD_SE_2.3.45_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_minicombohd_se_2345_app_starts.py, run_dump_minicombohd_se_2345_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3516C 1.2.1") runs with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA14187DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) ("14020A002345", 12.87 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", initialises its userdb(64+64) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Mini Combo HD SE (System ID 14020A00) firmware 2.3.45 EMU (2016-2-3) on a 16 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3516C / M3503 rev B receiver with 256 MB DDR3.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3516C 1.2.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xAE000200, and a CH455 4-digit LED / IR sensor eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA) (" ON " -> " on ").
